description: A plugin dependency: a bare plugin name string, or an object with name and optional semver range / marketplace.

anyOf.description: Plugin name resolved within the declaring plugin's marketplace. The CLI also accepts name@marketplace and name@marketplace@^range spellings that the docs do not describe.

name.description: Plugin name; resolves in the same marketplace unless 'marketplace' is set.

version.description: Semver range, for example ~2.1.0, ^2.0, >=1.4 or =2.1.0; the dependency is fetched at the highest tagged version satisfying it (tags: {plugin-name}--v{version}). Pre-releases need an opt-in suffix like ^2.0.0-0. The CLI does not type-check this field (a JSON number passes `claude plugin validate` unchanged, oracle-verified; behavior at resolve time for a non-string value is undocumented).

marketplace.description: Different marketplace to resolve 'name' in; blocked unless listed in the root marketplace's allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn.
